title: PortainerComputeLimitsReference
description: Describes the compute and memory limits applied to a container as defined in its HostConfig, retrieved via Portainer's Docker API proxy.

Id.description: Unique container identifier (the Docker container ID).

HostConfig.description: Runtime configuration options applied when the container was created, including CPU and memory restrictions.

NanoCpus.description: CPU allocation in nanoseconds per second. 1e9 represents one full CPU core. For example, 2e9 means two CPUs allocated. If 0, the container can use all host CPUs.

CpuQuota.description: CFS (Completely Fair Scheduler) CPU quota in microseconds for the container. Used with CpuPeriod to define CPU time limits. 0 means no enforced limit.

CpuPeriod.description: CFS scheduling period in microseconds for the container’s CPU quota. Typically 100000. Together with CpuQuota, defines CPU cap = CpuQuota / CpuPeriod cores.

CpuShares.description: Relative CPU weight used by the scheduler when multiple containers share CPU. Default is 1024. Not a hard limit, but a prioritization hint.

CpusetCpus.description: Comma-separated list of specific CPU cores (e.g., '0,1' or '1-3') assigned to the container. Empty means no core pinning.

Memory.description: Maximum memory (in bytes) available to the container. A value of 0 indicates no memory limit (can use all host RAM).

MemoryReservation.description: Soft memory limit (in bytes). The container is guaranteed this amount if available, but can use more if free memory exists.

MemorySwap.description: Total memory plus swap limit (in bytes). A value of 0 disables swap limit; -1 means unlimited swap. Often set to twice the Memory value.

PidsLimit.description: Maximum number of processes (PIDs) allowed inside the container. null or 0 means unlimited.

BlkioWeight.description: Block IO relative weight (between 10 and 1000). Controls disk I/O priority among containers. Default 0 means no explicit weighting.

IOMaximumIOps.description: Maximum I/O operations per second (IOPS) allowed for the container’s block devices. 0 disables enforcement.

IOMaximumBandwidth.description: Maximum I/O throughput (in bytes per second) allowed for the container’s block devices. 0 disables enforcement.

ShmSize.description: Size (in bytes) of the /dev/shm shared memory segment available to the container. Default is 67,108,864 bytes (64MB).

RestartPolicy.description: Defines the container restart behavior if it exits or fails.

MaximumRetryCount.description: Maximum retry count for 'on-failure' policy. Ignored for other modes.

Privileged.description: Indicates if the container is running in privileged mode (full access to host devices and kernel features).

NetworkMode.description: Specifies the container’s networking mode (e.g., 'bridge', 'host', 'none', 'container:<id>', or 'ingress' for swarm).
